description: A Java interface extending an Adapter that specifies criteria and actions for modify commands within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: ModifyCommandAdapter
classes.description: An interface that provides default implementations for criteria and actions related to modify commands, specialized for a given Command type.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns a set containing the criteria for modify commands, specifically the COMMANDS criterion.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a set of actions (CREATE, MODIFY, DELETE) applicable to modify commands.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is for responses, returns false.
